title: Dental PPO Plans Pre-Treatment Estimates
content:
**Who may request.** A participating or non-participating practice, or the member, may request a pre-treatment estimate under the Dental PPO Plans for any proposed procedure. An estimate is recommended when the proposed fee exceeds the plan's estimate recommendation amount, and is never required for payment.

**Active enrollment.** An estimate may be issued only while the enrollment is active, as the enrollment record shows.

**How an estimate is figured.** The estimate is computed with the same steps as a claim line, as if the service were performed on the issue date, using the accumulators as they stand on that date. It is issued within the plan's estimate turnaround (business days) of the date received. Its last valid date is the issue date plus the plan's estimate validity, in calendar days.

**Not a guarantee.** An estimate is not a guarantee of payment: the claim for the service is adjudicated on the facts on its date of service (eligibility, remaining maximum, frequency and network status), and a service performed after the last valid date is adjudicated the same way without regard to the estimate.

**Voiding.** An estimate is voided with the coverage-ended void remark when the enrollment terminates or is cancelled, and with the practice-request void remark when the requesting practice withdraws the treatment plan. A void references the voided estimate line, and an estimate line can be voided once.

### Validity example (hypothetical, 180-day validity)
An estimate issued on 10 January of a non-leap year is valid through 9 July of that year (10 January plus 180 calendar days).
